name: Kosovo
fact: Nestled among dramatic limestone cliffs in the Accursed Mountains, Rugova Canyon features pristine mountain springs, cascading waterfalls, and spectacular hiking routes.

name: Latvia
fact: Riga boasts one of the world's richest collections of Art Nouveau architecture, with more than eight hundred ornate facades adorning its historic boulevards.

name: Liechtenstein
fact: The scenic Liechtenstein Trail connects all eleven municipalities along a seventy-five-kilometer route, guiding hikers through panoramic Alpine pastures, castle ruins, and historic vineyards.

name: Lithuania
fact: Renowned for laser technology, Lithuania produces world-class ultra-fast scientific lasers that equip top research laboratories, universities, and space missions worldwide.

name: Luxembourg
fact: In 2020, Luxembourg became the first country in the world to make all standard public transport nationwide, including trains, trams, and buses, completely free of charge.

name: Malta
fact: Constructed more than five millennia ago, Malta's remarkable Megalithic Temples rank among the world's earliest free-standing stone structures and are recognized as UNESCO World Heritage treasures.

name: Moldova
fact: Recognized by Guinness World Records, the subterranean cellars of Mileștii Mici house nearly two million vintage bottles within dozens of kilometers of underground limestone galleries.

name: Monaco
fact: Overlooking the Mediterranean from sheer cliffs, the Oceanographic Museum has spearheaded marine research and coral conservation since its establishment in 1910.

name: Montenegro
fact: Durmitor National Park protects the dramatic Tara River Canyon, Europe's deepest river gorge, celebrated for pristine turquoise waters and untouched alpine wilderness.

name: Netherlands
fact: Boasting more bicycles than permanent residents, the country maintains over thirty-five thousand kilometers of dedicated cycling paths that foster an extraordinarily green urban lifestyle.

name: North Macedonia
fact: Formed millions of years ago, Lake Ohrid is one of Europe's oldest and deepest lakes, preserving over two hundred unique endemic species in its crystalline waters.

name: Norway
fact: Deep inside an Arctic mountain on Spitsbergen, the Svalbard Global Seed Vault safely preserves over one million seed varieties to secure global food biodiversity.

name: Poland
fact: The subterranean Wieliczka Salt Mine enchants visitors with an underground cathedral, ornate chandeliers, and sacred statues sculpted entirely from natural rock salt.

name: Portugal
fact: Portugal supplies more than half of the planet's cork, sustainably harvesting the bark of cork oak forests by hand without cutting down a single tree.
